Étape 3Logarithme des deux membres⟦3 \cdot 2^{x} = 4 \cdot 3^{x}⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(3 \cdot 2^{x}) = \log(4 \cdot 3^{x})⟧(log des deux membres)⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(3) + \log(2^{x}) = \log(4) + \log(3^{x})⟧(log(ab) = log a + log b)⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(3) + x \cdot \log(2) = \log(4) + x \cdot \log(3)⟧(log(a^A) = A · log(a))⟦\iff⟧⟦x \cdot \log(2) + \log(3) = x \cdot \log(3) + \log(4)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x(\log(2) - \log(3)) = \log(4) - \log(3)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x = \frac{\log(4) - \log(3)}{\log(2) - \log(3)}⟧(car ⟦\log(2) - \log(3) \neq 0⟧)⟦\phantom{x} = \frac{\log\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)}{\log\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)}⟧(log a − log b = log(a/b))
Solution⟦S = \left\{\frac{\log\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)}{\log\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)}\right\} \text{, soit } x \approx -0{,}710⟧

Étape 3Logarithme des deux membres⟦2^{x} = 4 \cdot 3^{x}⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(2^{x}) = \log(4 \cdot 3^{x})⟧(log des deux membres)⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(2^{x}) = \log(4) + \log(3^{x})⟧(log(ab) = log a + log b)⟦\iff⟧⟦x \cdot \log(2) = \log(4) + x \cdot \log(3)⟧(log(a^A) = A · log(a))⟦\iff⟧⟦x \cdot \log(2) = x \cdot \log(3) + \log(4)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x(\log(2) - \log(3)) = \log(4)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x = \frac{\log(4)}{\log(2) - \log(3)}⟧(car ⟦\log(2) - \log(3) \neq 0⟧)⟦\phantom{x} = \frac{\log(4)}{\log\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)}⟧(log a − log b = log(a/b))
Solution⟦S = \left\{\frac{\log(4)}{\log\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)}\right\} \text{, soit } x \approx -3{,}419⟧

Étape 1Logarithme des deux membres⟦2^{x + 4} = 3^{x - 1}⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(2^{x + 4}) = \log(3^{x - 1})⟧(log des deux membres)⟦\iff⟧⟦(x + 4) \cdot \log(2) = (x - 1) \cdot \log(3)⟧(log(a^A) = A · log(a))⟦\iff⟧⟦x \cdot \log(2) + 4\log(2) = x \cdot \log(3) - \log(3)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(3) + 4\log(2) = x(\log(3) - \log(2))⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x = \frac{\log(3) + 4\log(2)}{\log(3) - \log(2)}⟧(car ⟦\log(3) - \log(2) \neq 0⟧)⟦\phantom{x} = \frac{\log(48)}{\log\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)}⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\log(3) + 4\log(2) = \log(3 \cdot 2^{4})⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\phantom{\log(3) + 4\log(2)} = \log(48)⟧⟦\log(3) - \log(2) = \log\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)

Étape 1Logarithme des deux membres⟦2^{x + 7} = 4^{5x + 2}⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(2^{x + 7}) = \log(4^{5x + 2})⟧(log des deux membres)⟦\iff⟧⟦(x + 7) \cdot \log(2) = (5x + 2) \cdot \log(4)⟧(log(a^A) = A · log(a))⟦\iff⟧⟦x \cdot \log(2) + 7\log(2) = 5x \cdot \log(4) + 2\log(4)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦7\log(2) - 2\log(4) = x(5\log(4) - \log(2))⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x = \frac{7\log(2) - 2\log(4)}{5\log(4) - \log(2)}⟧(car ⟦5\log(4) - \log(2) \neq 0⟧)⟦\phantom{x} = \frac{\log(8)}{\log(512)}⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦7\log(2) - 2\log(4) = \log\left(\frac{2^{7}}{4^{2}}\right)⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\phantom{7\log(2) - 2\log(4)} = \log(8)⟧⟦5\log(4) - \log(2) = \log\left(\frac{4^{5}}{2}\right)⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\phantom{5\log(4) - \log(2)} = \log(512)⟧

Étape 3Logarithme des deux membres⟦3 \cdot 2^{x} = 3^{x}⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(3 \cdot 2^{x}) = \log(3^{x})⟧(log des deux membres)⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(3) + \log(2^{x}) = \log(3^{x})⟧(log(ab) = log a + log b)⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(3) + x \cdot \log(2) = x \cdot \log(3)⟧(log(a^A) = A · log(a))⟦\iff⟧⟦x \cdot \log(2) + \log(3) = x \cdot \log(3)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log(3) = x(\log(3) - \log(2))⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x = \frac{\log(3)}{\log(3) - \log(2)}⟧(car ⟦\log(3) - \log(2) \neq 0⟧)⟦\phantom{x} = \frac{\log(3)}{\log\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)}⟧(log a − log b = log(a/b))
Solution⟦S = \left\{\frac{\log(3)}{\log\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)}\right\} \text{, soit } x \approx 2{,}710⟧
